mechanics.summary: Use AGL instead of STR for a HEAVY WEAPONS roll to fire a mounted weapon.
trigger: actor fires mounted weapon using Heavy Weapons

unknowns: Whether the weapon is mounted requires item data.

mechanics.summary: Use INT for a HEAVY WEAPONS roll to fire artillery.
trigger: actor fires artillery using Heavy Weapons

unknowns: Whether a weapon is artillery requires item data.

mechanics.summary: A person or group trying to remain hidden is the active party in the opposed RECON roll and must have more successes than the opponent to remain undetected.
trigger: person or group attempts to remain undetected

outcome.value: hiding party remains undetected only on opposed-roll win

exceptions: Only the hiding party can push this opposed roll.

unknowns: Whether the parties are attempting stealth requires input.

mechanics.summary: When PCs sneak side by side, only the PC with the lowest RECON skill level rolls, and that result applies to the whole group.
trigger: PC group sneaks side by side

outcome.value: select lowest Recon skill level as group roller; apply result to group

unknowns: Whether the PCs are sneaking side by side requires input.

mechanics.summary: When PCs scout at the same time, only the PC with the highest RECON skill level rolls, and that result applies to the whole group.

outcome.value: select highest Recon skill level as group roller; apply result to group

unknowns: Whether the PCs are scouting at the same time requires input.

mechanics.summary: A character does not need a level in a skill to learn a specialty categorized under that skill.

outcome.value: allow specialty without associated skill level

mechanics.summary: Brawler gives +1 to CLOSE COMBAT rolls in unarmed close combat.
trigger: Brawler makes unarmed Close Combat roll

unknowns: Unarmed attack selection requires action context.

mechanics.summary: Melee gives +1 to CLOSE COMBAT rolls for hand-to-hand combat weapons.
trigger: Melee specialist makes Close Combat roll with hand-to-hand weapon

unknowns: Weapon category requires item data.

mechanics.summary: Killer allows an incapacitated person to be killed outright without the normal negative effects.
trigger: Killer attempts to kill incapacitated person outright

outcome.value: kill outright without normal negative effects

unknowns: Intent and target eligibility require input.

mechanics.summary: Martial Artist sets the critical-injury threshold of unarmed close-combat attacks to 3 instead of 4.
trigger: Martial Artist makes unarmed close-combat attack

unknowns: Unarmed attack selection requires action context.

mechanics.summary: Machinegunner gives +1 to HEAVY WEAPONS rolls for all machine guns.
trigger: Machinegunner fires machine gun with Heavy Weapons

mechanics.summary: Launcher Crew gives +1 to HEAVY WEAPONS rolls for grenade launchers and missile launchers.
trigger: Launcher Crew fires grenade or missile launcher

mechanics.summary: Redleg gives +1 to HEAVY WEAPONS rolls when firing mortars and howitzers.
Vehicle Gunner gives +1 to HEAVY WEAPONS rolls for vehicle-mounted cannons.
Load Carrier adds four encumbrance units to combat-gear capacity and four units to backpack capacity.
NBC gives +1 to all STAMINA infection rolls, including infection rolls triggered by radiation or chemical agents.
trigger: NBC specialist makes Stamina infection roll

unknowns: Whether a roll is an infection roll requires rule context.

mechanics.summary: NBC allows identification of nuclear, biological, and chemical weapon effects on personnel and equipment.
trigger: NBC specialist identifies NBC weapon effects

unknowns: What effects are observable is Referee context.

mechanics.summary: Ranger gives +1 to STAMINA rolls for marching, resisting hypothermia, and other hardships.

unknowns: Whether a hardship is applicable requires Referee input.

mechanics.summary: Rider negates the negative modifier for shooting from horseback.

unknowns: Mounted state requires token or user input.

mechanics.summary: Combat Awareness lets the character draw two initiative cards and choose one when drawing initiative.
Forward Observer treats its RECON skill level as one step higher when directing indirect fire.
Historian can roll RECON on arriving at a new location; on success, the Referee can provide significant past information if any exists.

outcome.value: on success Referee may provide significant past information

exceptions: The printed text conditions information on something significant having happened there.

unknowns: Location history and information disclosure are Referee managed.

mechanics.summary: Intelligence can roll RECON when spotting enemy troops, vehicles, or weapons; on success, the Referee should provide their statistics.
trigger: Intelligence specialist spots enemy troops, vehicles, or weapons

unknowns: What is spotted and what statistics are revealed require Referee input.

mechanics.summary: Investigator can roll RECON after spending a stretch or more investigating a crime or battle scene; on success, the Referee should provide useful information about what happened and when.
trigger: Investigator spends at least one stretch investigating crime or battle scene

value.success: provide useful event and timing information

unknowns: Elapsed time and discovered information require tracking and Referee input.

mechanics.summary: Cook adds one food ration when the specialist or another group member successfully forages, hunts, or fishes.
trigger: group member succeeds at foraging, hunting, or fishing

unknowns: The source activity outcome must be recorded.

mechanics.summary: Chemist allows correct identification of chemical substances.

unknowns: Substance identity is Referee-managed information.

mechanics.summary: When building a base, Logistician can roll COMMAND instead of any listed skill if at least one person helps.
trigger: Logistician builds base with at least one helper
exceptions: At least one helper is required.

unknowns: Base task and helper eligibility require input.

mechanics.summary: Tactician can roll COMMAND on spotting an enemy force; on success, the Referee must provide useful information about its organization and objectives.

outcome.value: on success provide useful organization and objective information

unknowns: Enemy-force scope and information require Referee input.

mechanics.summary: Linguist allows a chosen additional language to be used well enough to be taken as native on a successful PERSUASION roll.

unknowns: Chosen language requires character data.

mechanics.summary: Before a PERSUASION roll, the active party states its intended outcome; the requested outcome must be within reason, with feasibility decided by the Referee.

outcome.value: block goals Referee determines impossible or directly against opponent interests

unknowns: Reasonableness is a Referee determination.

mechanics.summary: Convincing, bluffing, or charming uses an opposed PERSUASION roll; it costs a slow action only to the active party, and success sways the opponent to the stated goal.
trigger: actor attempts to persuade, bluff, or charm opponent

outcome.value: on opposed-roll win, opponent is swayed to stated goal

exceptions: The opponent may reasonably request something in return, and the active party may accept or decline.
Extra net successes may produce further bonus only if the Referee finds it appropriate.

unknowns: Opponent concessions and extra-success bonus are Referee decisions.

mechanics.summary: Each listed positive negotiating-position factor gives +1 or more at the Referee's discretion; each listed negative factor gives -1 to the active PERSUASION roll.

positiveFactors: Referee determines case is presented very well
actor outranks opponent when both military of same nationality
negativeFactors: not in same hex (more than 5 meters)
opponent outranks actor when both military of same nationality

exceptions: Positive amount beyond +1 is at Referee discretion.

unknowns: Most factors and any positive increase above +1 require Referee input.

mechanics.summary: A group is usually addressed through its leader or spokesperson; if agreement is reached, the rest usually follows, while a leaderless group has individual opponents.

outcome.value: resolve against leader when present; otherwise resolve individual opponents

exceptions: The printed text uses 'usually' for both leader address and follower behavior.

unknowns: Leadership and whether followers comply require Referee input.

mechanics.summary: Interrogation to gain information is opposed by the prisoner's STAMINA instead of PERSUASION.

unknowns: Prisoner status and interrogation intent require input.

mechanics.summary: Interrogation receives +1 because the opponent is held captive.

unknowns: Captivity requires input.

mechanics.summary: Unlike normal PERSUASION, interrogation can be used against PCs and can force disclosure of information.

unknowns: Information scope requires Referee input.

mechanics.summary: After a successful opposed PERSUASION roll to negotiate an NPC's asking price down, reduce the bullet price by 10% for each success rolled.
trigger: PC succeeds at opposed Persuasion to buy NPC item
exceptions: For payment other than bullets, the Referee determines the equivalent result.

unknowns: Asking price and non-bullet value require Referee input.

mechanics.summary: After a successful PERSUASION roll to sell an item, increase the NPC offer by 10% for each success, provided the NPC can pay; the seller then chooses whether to accept.
trigger: PC succeeds at Persuasion to sell item
exceptions: Increase assumes the NPC can pay the sum.

unknowns: Offer, NPC means, and acceptance require input.

mechanics.summary: Bartering between PCs is handled without dice rolls.
For common gear, roll D6; a result of 3 or higher means the item is available, and a new availability roll can be made each week.

unknowns: Settlement availability context requires input.

mechanics.summary: For scarce gear, roll D6; a result of 5 or 6 means the item is available, and a new availability roll can be made each week.

unknowns: Settlement availability context requires input.

referenceData.notes: Printed probability lookup for initial skill rolls; it does not alter the resolution procedure.
Printed probability lookup for pushed skill rolls; it does not alter the resolution procedure.

values.scarce: one item; D6 heavy-weapons ammunition rounds; 2D6x5 liters fuel; D6 sticks dynamite
